generators.carrier: Vec K Q under a reversible relabelling tau of sectors Q

relations.statement: The sesquilinear form defined by a star-ring pack and an enum of sectors is preserved by permU for any reversible relabelling.
relations.hypotheses: StarRingPack K, DecidableEq Q, Enum Q, Reversible tau

relations.statement: If a matrix G is invariant under every permutation in a transitive set S, then its diagonal entries are constant.
relations.hypotheses: hS : every sigma in S leaves G Invariant; hT : TransitiveOn S

lemmas.statement: Given the imported assumption that the readout is invariant under a transitive permutation set S, the diagonal of the readout matrix is constant.

near_misses.claim: Readout invariance under relabelling holds for all sector sets.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Sectors with distinguished labels break transitivity, so the diagonal is constant only on orbits.

open_obligations: The transitive sector symmetry law is an imported assumption and is not derived from primitive difference.
No grounded derivation of readout invariance under sector relabelling from finite-theory primitives.
Identification of which sector labels are distinguished remains open (run next-steps item 1).
